title: Shattered Strand
wikitext:
[[Image:The Shattered Strand.jpg|thumb|The Shattered Strand]]
'''The Shattered Strand''' is a coastal area in Azshara, lining the north side of the [[Bay of Storms]]. It is densely populated by [[hydra]]s, [[sea giant]]s, [[makrura]] and [[murloc]]s. The strand is also the location of the [[Temple of Arkkoran]] and the [[Tower of Eldara]].
